decisions.reason: As a multi-model line that is adjacent to the core fluid-management business, it likely remains worth carrying under organizational slack unless clear sales shortfalls against aspirations emerge.

This coolant filtration product builds directly on the firm's established capabilities and customer base, so a behavioral-theory management would likely retain it absent strong evidence of persistent underperformance.

Because it is close to the firm's existing filtration offer and can be supported through the same engineering, assembly and service resources, management would likely keep it while results remain uncertain.
